title: Traffic Management Designer Victoria
abstract: Work from home in Victoria as a Traffic Management Designer delivering TMPs and TGSs for major civil projects.
bullets: Work from home anywhere in Victoria
Competitive salary with career growth opportunities
Design major civil and construction traffic management projects
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Traffic Management Designer?
How many years' experience do you have in the construction industry?
Do you hold a Construction Induction Safety certificate (White Card)?
content_text:
Traffic Management Designer required for a well-established Traffic Planning/ Traffic Management Company.
We are a fast-growing Traffic Management Company with headquarters on the Sunshine Coast.  The position available can be accommodated as a work from home position in Victoria. 
The desired applicant will, at a minimum, have the Vic Roads New L3 Traffic Management Design Qualification in Victoria with at least 2 years, high level experience in traffic management design together with a complete understanding of Vic Roads Category 1, 2 and 3 Standards. It is essential to have experience in Traffic Management Design with either civil or building construction planning. 
As a Traffic Management Planner you will have:
- Proven experience in Traffic Management Design, with an ability to multitask in a fast-paced team environment
- Ability to Develop and review Traffic Guidance Schemes and Traffic Management Plans in accordance with relevant legislation, policies and procedures.
- Ability to work under pressure and meet short deadlines.
- Ability to “Work from Home”.
- A high level of communication skills to consult with fellow team members, clients and, where necessary, authorities. You will require an ability to build strong relationships.
- Extensive experience with Rapidplan and an understanding of high-level technical traffic management designs
- Proven skills for Traffic management onsite visits and the ability to interpret technical drawings 
At Crompton Concepts, we believe in developing our people to their full potential so they can deliver effective, practical and innovative workplace solutions.  Salary for this role will be commensurate with experience of the successful applicant. 
Applicants are invited to submit a resume of no more than 3 pages, plus a single page covering letter personally addressed to the Directors, explaining the skills and experience you’ll bring to our firm. Your cover letter should highlight why you are the best person for the role and can deliver the exceptional levels of traffic management we seek. Applications without this covering letter will not be considered. 
Please note only candidates shortlisted for this role will be contacted. 
Applicant introductions via recruitment agencies will not be accepted.
